rules_evaluated.evidence: TWO findings under this rule. (a) Block-presence sub-issue, CARRIED FORWARD FROM PRIOR VERDICT — not re-argued: block is present (lines 172-180) and covers Entis/Klaassen×2/da Costa, but the practitioner claim at line 40 ('Cherny calls parallel worktrees his biggest productivity unlock') has no stamp of its own — the block instead defers Cherny to lecture files' stamps ('stamps live there; confirm each stays in sync'). (b) NEW — §11a freshness-stamp-arithmetic: computed by hand for all 4 stamps (grep -n confirms dates). L176 checked:2026-05-25 due:2026-11-25 — checked+6mo=2026-11-25 matches shown due exactly; publication 2026-04-22 so correct due is 2026-10-22 — ~1mo too generous. L177 checked:2026-05-25 due:2026-11-25 — checked+6mo matches; publication Klaassen 2026-02-09 → correct due 2026-08-09, which has ALREADY PASSED as of today 2026-08-13 — stamp reads OK/future while the true window closed 4 days ago. L178 checked:2026-05-25 due:2026-11-25 — checked+6mo matches; source dated 2025-08-18 and (per §2a analysis above) is an on-clock practice claim, so correct due (2026-02-18) passed ~6 months ago — a genuinely stale source reads OK. L179 checked:2026-07-30 due:2027-01-30 — checked+6mo=2027-01-30 matches exactly; publication ~2026-05-23 → correct due ~2026-11-23, ~2mo too generous. HARM: §11a exists so `source-freshness.sh`'s automated BLOCK/WARN gate catches sources whose real-world window has closed before a cohort ships; I ran it (`bash curriculum/evals/scripts/source-freshness.sh --target 2026-08-13`, exit 1, 59 BLOCK + 87 WARN elsewhere in the repo) and this file appears in NEITHER list — the wrong-arithmetic stamps are invisible to the mechanical gate exactly as §11a predicts. Harm is concretely present at L177 (already past true due-date, unflagged) and L178 (materially stale practice-claim, unflagged); L176/L179 are minor overgenerous drift only.
